verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Pipecat automatically reviewing real calls with AI to score quality, flag failures, or analyze resolution. Pipecat Evals runs scripted conversations against the agent as behavioral tests rather than analyzing completed calls. Audio recording, transcript capture and metrics are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such analysis, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
